name: org-workspace
description: A light global guide for an org folder of many repos. /org-init discovers the repos and maps who calls whom (SYSTEM-MAP.md, every connection cited file:line on both sides) and writes a short managed block into the CLAUDE.md at the folder root — the file Claude Code already loads — recording where the truth of each thing lives. /org-learn proposes a small update to that block from a conversation. Pointers, not copies; a ~1k-token budget; nothing is written without the user's OK.
